en: A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a narrow, slightly curving street lined with tightly packed multi‑story houses with steep tiled roofs. The street slopes gently downward between older masonry buildings; in the distance leafy trees rise above the rooftops, possibly indicating a hill or town wall beyond. At the bottom right corner there is a printed heraldic coat of arms featuring a double‑headed eagle with a small central shield.
